text:
jamal: hey @maria need to push canary for v2.14.5 to prod to validate kv-cache fix, but I don't have 'releaser' role. change window open now? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Change window is 23:00-02:00 UTC. Who can press? @revathi is on call but currently boxed. We prefer a dedicated releaser or a temporary claim.

jamal: plan is: canary 5% -> monitor -> 25% -> 100% if metrics stable. need to pin runtime to 2026-03-20-build. I can run preflight checks but can't press.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: policy check: user jamal missing role 'releaser'. Available options: 1) JIT grant via `/claim` 2) Delegation by a releaser 3) SRE manual intervention. See /docs/deploy-perms for details.

oncall-ops: If we do JIT, MFA + approval from one releaser required. @maria can you delegate or approve?

maria: I'm not a releaser. I can approve a delegation if @revathi or @alex issues the token. @revathi are you able to create a temp token?

revathi: I'm shadowing an incident but can grant a 30m temp token if SRE confirms there's a rollback plan. Send me rollback steps and I'll create it.

jamal: Rollback steps (draft):
1) set service image -> v2.14.4 (force pin)
2) flip feature flag `kv-cache-v2` -> off
3) run smoke tests: `make smoke-prod`
4) monitor 20m, if error-rate > 1.5% revert routing and alert customers.
I'll paste a runbook entry after I run preflight.

maria: Need release-note link and impacted customer list in this thread before full push.

jamal: release notes: https://redwoodhq.internal/releases/v2.14.5 - kv-cache bugfix, TTL handling, no schema change. Affected: web search indexers (low volume), internal ingestion.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: revathi created temp token tok-6d9b, expires in 00:30. JIT grant recorded. MFA required to use token. Audit entry created.

jamal: thanks — running preflight now. Command I will run:
```
/deploy canary --release v2.14.5 --env prod --pin=sha256:abc123 --percent 5
```

oncall-ops: Confirming MFA: jamal completed MFA at 1791234525.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started. id=c-20260320-01. routing: 5% traffic to the canary variant.

maria: :eyes: watching metrics. If error-rate > 1.5% for 5m we roll back immediately.

jamal: smoke succeeded, no obvious errors after 6m. continuing to monitor; will wait until 20m mark then bump to 25%.

revathi: documented the delegation in the incident log and set token to auto-revoke if rollback triggered.

jamal: bumping to 25% now:
`/deploy promote --canary c-20260320-01 --percent 25`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promote accepted. Note: token tok-6d9b will expire at scheduled time. Audit recorded.

oncall-ops: infra looks stable. keeping monitoring loop open.

maria: After 1h at 25% with no regression we can consider 100%, but update release notes with canary results first. Jamal please post when you promote to 100%.

jamal: will do. thanks everyone :v:
